priorities.heading: Lower Healthcare Costs & Expand Access
priorities.quote: Mike broke up healthcare bureaucracies that blocked new clinics from opening and expanded telehealth access so affordable, high-quality care is available to everyone, especially working families and seniors.

priorities.heading: Lower the Cost of Living & Keep More of What You Earn
priorities.quote: In Congress, Mike will cut the wasteful spending that drives prices up and keep your money in your pocket.

priorities.heading: Grow Jobs & Remove Barriers to Opportunity
priorities.quote: In Congress, he'll fight to reduce the regulations that raise costs and limit opportunity for Tampa Bay families and businesses.

cost-of-living.heading: Lower the Cost of Living & Keep More of What You Earn
cost-of-living.quote: In Congress, Mike will cut the wasteful spending that drives prices up and keep your money in your pocket.

health-care.heading: Lower Healthcare Costs & Expand Access
health-care.quote: Mike broke up healthcare bureaucracies that blocked new clinics from opening and expanded telehealth access so affordable, high-quality care is available to everyone, especially working families and seniors.

immigration.heading: Secure the Border
immigration.quote: We need to finish the wall, deport the criminals and fraudsters, and restore law and order at our southern border.

foreign-policy.heading: Support Our Veterans & Military
foreign-policy.quote: He supports a strong national defense and a military that is focused on protecting America, not advancing political agendas.

climate-energy.heading: Protect Our Community From Overreach
climate-energy.quote: Mike will fight to ensure no data center is built in our community without local approval and a guarantee it won't raise your energy bills or harm our environment.
climate-energy.note: From his section on data centers, on keeping energy bills from rising.

priorities.heading: Tampa Airport
priorities.quote: Kathy has secured more than $114 million in the last three years to modernize Tampa International Airport (TPA), helping keep it among the nation's top airports while strengthening our regional economy, boosting tourism, and supporting good-paying local jobs.

priorities.heading: Port Tampa Bay
priorities.quote: Over the past four years alone, Kathy secured more than $63 million to expand Port Tampa Bay - creating jobs, strengthening the local economy, and helping businesses move more goods through Florida's largest port.

priorities.heading: Transportation & Transit
priorities.quote: Kathy has secured more than $250 million to improve roads, bridges, transit, and waterfront infrastructure across Tampa.

cost-of-living.heading: Meet Kathy
cost-of-living.quote: From securing federal investments that drive the local economy to championing landmark environmental protections, she works tirelessly to lower family costs, create good-paying jobs, and protect Florida’s unique way of life.

housing.heading: Housing
housing.quote: Kathy has secured more than $76 million to build and preserve affordable housing in Tampa.

health-care.heading: About Kathy
health-care.quote: She worked to pass the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law and led bipartisan bills to improve healthcare for our nation’s sickest kids, including by expanding access to life-saving treatments for cancer and other rare diseases.

foreign-policy.heading: MacDill Air Force Base
foreign-policy.quote: Along with championing funding for service member and civilian pay raises and improved military housing, Kathy has secured millions of dollars to expand the Tinker PreK-8 school on base and construct a Joint Special Operations University to educate our nation’s special operators.
foreign-policy.note: From her section on MacDill Air Force Base (military pay and base projects).

climate-energy.heading: About Kathy
climate-energy.quote: Kathy Castor will continue to fight for a diverse and strong Tampa Bay economy that keeps costs for families in check, keeps health care and energy affordable, and protects our way of life.
climate-energy.note: Her only line on energy (keeping it affordable), from her About page.

priorities.heading: Fiscal Responsibility
priorities.quote: Restore fiscal discipline, balance the budget, and protect future generations from crushing debt.

priorities.heading: Constitutional Government
priorities.quote: The Constitution limits the government—not the people.

priorities.heading: Individual Liberty
priorities.quote: Protect the freedoms guaranteed by the Bill of Rights and defend individual choice.

cost-of-living.heading: Economy & Small Business
cost-of-living.quote: Lower taxes, reduce regulation, and let American entrepreneurs succeed.

health-care.heading: Healthcare Reform
health-care.quote: Restore patient choice, medical freedom, price transparency, and competition while reducing unnecessary federal interference in healthcare.

immigration.heading: Border Security & Immigration
immigration.quote: Secure every border and port of entry while supporting legal immigration and the rule of law.

foreign-policy.heading: National Defense
foreign-policy.quote: Peace through strength, constitutional accountability, and unwavering support for our troops.

climate-energy.heading: Energy & American Independence
climate-energy.quote: Reliable, affordable energy strengthens our economy, protects national security, and reduces dependence on foreign adversaries.
